reviews.comment: This guy honestly grades this class too easy, he is super generous with partial credit on exams and quizzes. There is weekly homework  which he literally gives the answer to and all you have to do is copy the answers. He is a good lecturer and cares about his students. I truly don't think you can fail this class because of how easy he grades.

Very kind and understanding! Always willing to help answer questions, provide resources, and give explanations to his students. All of the material that he uses are posted on canvas. His class is not exam heavy. Most of your grade will come from quizzes which are based on the homework, and he posts the answers to all of the homework problems.

Very nice guy! Everyone in my section did well. There's weekly quizzes, which are all just 1 question based on the HW due that week. TA gives good feedback on the quizzes. Super accommodating professor, very nice and tries to chat before lecture with students. Ultimate chill guy!

Lectures consist of him mostly coding homework problems which can be a bit annoying as coding is not a tested topic. Homework is very coding heavy, but you are allowed to use AI, so it is not as hard as 102 in a coding sense. The tests are not that hard if you know what you are doing. Overall he is a very good guy and very willing  to work with you

Super nice and understanding. The class material is hard material in general, but he made it easy if you go to class. He basically gives you all the Python code, but you can use AI on homework if you need. There were 2 exams and a final, but he gives generous curves and you can make your own cheat sheet. He extended due dates a couple times too.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very personable and cares about students. Need textbook, weekly homework and quiz based on the hw. 2 tests (10% each) and final was 35%. Pretty easy grader. Lots of resources on Canvas (videos, extra quizzes). Missed class a few times but always made up for it. Very sweet and knowledgeable, would recommend.

He is SO KIND and caring and you can tell he really cares about fluids and tries to explain the outside application of them. Every time I asked him a question before/during/after class, he thoroughly explained it to me and gave me extra information to make sure I understood. He is a fantastic professor with tons of resources available to students.

While his lectures are not the most exciting, they are clear and easy to follow when you pay attention. He is very welcoming and open to questions, very approachable. He was very fair in his expectations of us, what was on the syllabus was for the most part exactly what happened.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This man was an absolute godsend for 102. If you ask him, he will help you with whatever you are struggling on, and is incredible both in class and during office hours. Unfortunately, his lectures are pretty dry and not the easiest to follow, but I found it more helpful to just learn by trying rather than paying attention. Lots of quizzes though.

Caring professor but for people who did not have any coding experience this class was a nightmare. You work in groups however the labs are very difficult and they are a weekly thing. And lectures are not very helpful when it comes to doing the labs. I would only recommend this for those who have coded before.

Really cares about his students and is passionate in his career which makes it motivating to do good. Overall he is super smart and will overcomplicare topics sometimes, however he puts many resources on his webpage that is super helpful. Start labs early and ask questions, for he will really help you with any assignment.

Dr Socolofsky's lectures are well planned out. His real world experience with Python keeps the lectures interesting and helps you thoroughly understand the material. Homework assignments are standard. He creates a great learning environment and you can tell he really cares. Overall a very enjoyable class.

Professor Socolofsky is a great choice for 102, he's actually one of the few teachers that actually understand Python, helps a lot during group projects and the tests are pretty standard, pay attention in class and you'll do fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This was his first year of teaching ENGR102, and while there were a lot of programming assignments to be done outside of class, most of them aren't too difficult and there is always an extra credit problem on the homework assignments. He regularly walks around the class while everyone is doing group coding and makes sure that people understand it.
He explains the material well and wants to make sure his students understand it. The homework isn't bad. He has the solutions posted on his website and there are quizzes the day homework is due.
